# JSONL Beautifier

> A free online JSONL (JSON Lines) viewer and formatter. Paste JSONL text or open a file, and read each line as indented, syntax-highlighted JSON. It runs in the browser, has no API and needs no account.

Use it to read and inspect JSONL: one collapsible record per line, a text filter, pagination, a jump to a line number, and a large-file mode for input over 1 MB. It does not edit, convert or save files.

## Pages

- [JSONL Beautifier](https://jsonlbeautifier.com/index.md): what the tool does, how to use it, its limits, and what JSONL is
- [The tool](https://jsonlbeautifier.com/): the page a person opens to paste or open a JSONL file
